column1: # gates/bar.tsv — THE BAR (owner: PERF; decisions/perf.md PERF-1, PERF-2).
# `limit` rows: the wall-clock ceilings scripts/bar.sh judges in EVERY run, standing and full, at any load (GATES-20x;

# `run` rows: one per `scripts/bar.sh --record` — the trend of runs, never a ratchet (wall time on one
# device under its load). The deterministic counts are pinned in gates/waste.tsv (op `bar`), not here.
